hero.title: Technology innovation that works for cooperatives and SMEs.
hero.lede: AVITEK KUKM is a collaborative ecosystem that helps Indonesian cooperatives and SMEs turn real needs on the ground into steps for applying technology, shared learning, and opportunities to work together.

track.title: Four years of Korea–Indonesia cooperation
track.intro: AVITEK grew out of a long journey. These are the key milestones since the memorandum of understanding was signed.

items.title: Memorandum of understanding
items.text: Indonesia's Ministry of Cooperatives and SMEs and the INNOBIZ Association signed the smart factory project MoU in Jakarta on 28 February.

items.title: Training center opens
items.text: The Smart Factory Training Center opened at BINUS @Bekasi on 2 December.

items.title: Learning on site in Korea
items.text: Two weeks of training inside Korean smart factories, plus a business cooperation seminar at the SFTC.

items.title: Sharing results
items.text: A seminar at BINUS Alam Sutera where beneficiaries shared the impact of their smart factories.

items.title: AVITEK KUKM launches
items.text: The project reports its results, and AVITEK KUKM launches to carry them forward.

why.title: The technology is installed. Now the ecosystem needs looking after.
why.intro: Grants end; the need for mentoring, training, and networks doesn't. Without a home to carry it on, four years of know-how can easily scatter. AVITEK was formed so the results keep growing.

cards.title: For members
cards.text: Cooperatives and SMEs get a clear path to keep raising production capacity and competitiveness.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how AVITEK KUKM handles the personal data you send through this site, in line with Indonesia's Law No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection.

sections.title: Who manages your data
sections.text: Your data is managed by AVITEK KUKM (Association of Technology Innovation for Cooperatives and SMEs). Send questions about personal data to asosiasi.avitek@gmail.com.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.text: We only collect data from the Join form:
items: Data you provide: name, organization or business, email, WhatsApp number, category, and message.
Data recorded automatically: submission time, page language, browser type, and a hash of your IP address. Your IP address is not stored in its original form.

sections.title: How we use it
items: Process member registrations and partnership proposals.
Contact you about AVITEK KUKM membership, partnerships, and events.
Prevent spam and misuse of the form.

sections.title: Legal basis
sections.text: We process your data based on the consent you give by ticking the consent box on the form.

sections.title: Where it is stored
sections.text: Form data is stored in Google Sheets, and notification emails go to Gmail, both under the association's account. This site runs on Vercel hosting. These providers' servers may be located outside Indonesia.

sections.title: Who can access it
sections.text: Only the AVITEK KUKM board members and secretariat who need the data can access it. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.text: We keep data for as long as it is needed:
items: Member registrations and partnership proposals: for as long as the membership or cooperation continues, or until you ask us to delete them.
Attendance confirmations: deleted 1 year after the event.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can ask to access, correct, or delete your data, and withdraw your consent at any time, by emailing asosiasi.avitek@gmail.com. Withdrawing consent does not affect processing carried out before then.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text: This site uses one cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, to remember your language choice. We do not use tracking cookies.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: If this policy changes, the latest version and its effective date will appear on this page.
